title: Month 2 opens at the tower
headline: Month 2 begins in the tower on 20/20 HP, with nothing lost and 2 SP 5 CP in his pocket.
prose: Month 1 ended well: floor 1 under the tower is cleared, the tower bought Farms in B5, and the treasury holds 7 GP with 60 GP a month coming in. Floor 2 lies under the Humans' savanna next door in A5; floor 3 is past the Gnomes' B4, an L10 hex.

bullets.label: Next door
bullets.text: the Humans (Reeve Leopold, good: keeps the peace, an ally) in A5, the Gnomes (bad: robs its neighbours) in B4, the Tieflings (bad: squeezes its own people) in C5.

bullets.label: Rumours
bullets.text: the Humans are saving for Walls at A4; the Tieflings for a Treasury; the Gnomes have marched Thugs and Knights into C4 to rob the Tieflings' Mercenaries.
